description: This file defines the Article model within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing articles including CRUD operations, descriptions, associations with stores, SEO URLs, layouts, comments, ratings, and related data in the database.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: The Article class extends the base Model class and provides methods for managing articles, including creation, updating, deletion, and retrieval of articles, descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, layouts, comments, and ratings, interacting with the database accordingly.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Creates a new article record in the database and associates related data such as descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Updates an existing article record and its associated data in the database.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific article.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Removes an article and all related data such as descriptions, store links, comments, SEO URLs, and layouts from the database.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific article.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total number of articles matching certain filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description record for an article in different languages.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific article.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given article.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an article with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes store associations from an article.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Fetches all store IDs associated with an article.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to an article for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout assignments for an article.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all article layout associations for a specific layout.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves all layout assignments for an article.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many articles use a particular layout.

methods.name: editCommentStatus
methods.description: Updates the approval status of a comment.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a comment.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment.

methods.name: deleteCommentsByArticleId
methods.description: Removes all comments linked to an article.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating distribution for an article and optionally its comments.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Fetches comments based on various filters.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Returns the total count of comments based on filters.
